summary.name: Tailscale
summary.one_liner: Tailscale is a Zero Trust, identity-based connectivity platform that builds a mesh VPN overlay network to connect devices, services, cloud environments, and users.
use_cases: Replace a legacy VPN for remote team access
Connect CI/CD runners across multi-cloud environments
Access Kubernetes clusters and infrastructure remotely
SSH into home servers or NAS from anywhere
Connect edge and IoT devices to a private network
Connect SaaS and third-party apps without public exposure
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Tailscale as a Zero Trust, identity-based connectivity platform that replaces legacy VPN, SASE, and PAM tooling. It uses a mesh overlay network to connect devices across clouds, on-prem, and home networks. Policies can be applied to teams at scale, including GUI-based ACLs with SSO according to a user testimonial. It is described as cross-platform and infrastructure agnostic, and it is said to deploy in minutes. The page also includes user testimonials about NAT traversal, SSH access, and Kubernetes access, which are not independently verified.
notable: Mesh overlay network with identity-based Zero Trust access
Works across multi-cloud, on-prem, and home networks with NAT traversal
Listed in awesome-mac under Proxy and VPN Tools as freeware
caveats: Page says free 'in most cases', implying some paid tiers exist; details not on the page
Pricing details are not stated on the page beyond a 'Start free' prompt
